description: Read a Swiss Parliament member by PersonNumber, which need not equal Person.ID. overview returns identity and every base MemberCouncil affiliation without pagination. Select council_terms for historical council terms, committees for published MemberCommittee rows, or interests for declared interests; those sections accept limit and offset. Missing paid status means unknown, and empty interests do not establish absence of conflicts of interest. Metadata labels remain in the selected language.

language.description: Metadata language: de (default), fr, or it; uppercase is accepted.

limit.description: Relationship sections only: default 20, effective maximum 100 with notice. Omit for overview.

offset.description: Relationship sections only: default zero; continue with nextOffset. Omit for overview.

personNumber.description: Required positive Int32 PersonNumber as a decimal string; discover with chparl_search_members.
